scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Hello, what business are you here for?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
你好，請問你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
If you wish to join the Illusion Investigation Corps, you're lacking in skills yet.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
想加入幻覺調查隊的話，你目前的實力還不夠。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Please visit again when you have reached a certain level.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
等你達到一定等級後，再來找我吧。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff== You must be level 100 or higher to join. ==^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff== 角色等級須達到100級或以上才能加入。 ==^000000

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Hello, I'm Joel, the Commander of the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
你好，我是喬爾，幻覺調查隊的指揮官。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Have you ever heard of or experienced illusions?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
你聽說過幻覺，或親身經歷過嗎？

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Until now, illusions have been discovered all over the world and are somewhat known to the public.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
如今，世界各地都發現了幻覺現象，公眾也已經對此有所瞭解。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
It is also used as a hunting ground for many adventurers because it is easy to obtain rare materials.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
幻覺區域很容易找到稀有材料，因此成了許多冒險者的狩獵場。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Also, the monsters in Illusion are new monsters that have never been discovered before, and the monsters in Illusion are multiplying abnormally.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
幻覺中的魔物都是此前從未發現過的新種，而且數量正在異常繁殖。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Despite many adventurers hunting the monsters that exist in Illusion to obtain materials, the reason for the very rapid recovery of the population has not been identified.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
許多冒險者為了收集材料而獵殺幻覺中的魔物，但它們的數量為何能如此迅速地恢復，至今仍未查明。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Our Illusion Investigation Team was organized to uncover the mystery of the Illusion, and first we decided to figure out the ecology of the monsters inside the Illusion.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
我們成立幻覺調查隊，就是為了揭開幻覺的謎團。首先要弄清幻覺中魔物的生態。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
What we found was that all illusions are affected by dimensional rifts.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
調查發現，所有幻覺現象都受到次元裂縫的影響。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
I've been speculating that it might be related to the dimensional rift for a long time, but with the results of this investigation, it's clear.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
我一直猜測這可能與次元裂縫有關，而這次調查結果證實了這一點。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
There are still many adventurers visiting Illusion with a purpose, so the monster population is fortunately maintained.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
幸好仍有許多冒險者為了各自的目的前往幻覺區域，魔物數量才得以維持。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
If no one sets foot there, it's very dangerous because the monsters can go beyond saturation and invade other areas.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
如果沒有人前往，魔物數量就可能過度增長，甚至侵入其他區域，那會非常危險。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
For that reason, the number of individuals is still being investigated, and one investigator is currently assigned to each illusion.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
因此，我們仍在調查魔物的數量，併為每處幻覺區域派駐了一名調查員。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
And we're recruiting members with the ability to control the number of monsters inside Illusion.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
我們正在招募能夠控制幻覺區域內魔物數量的成員。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
And if you're an adventurer, you seem to be strong enough for that role...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
而你身為冒險者，似乎有足夠的實力勝任這項工作...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Would you like to join the Illusion Investigation Team and join us in investigating illusions?
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
你願意加入幻覺調查隊，和我們一起調查幻覺嗎？

scripts.text: I'm joining
scripts.translation: 我加入

scripts.text: I'll think about it
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
It's very meaningful.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
這項工作很有意義。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Please think about it before you tell me.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
請考慮清楚後再答覆我。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Okay, you're welcome!!
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
好，歡迎加入！！

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
The procedure is simple, please fill out the pledge here...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
手續很簡單，請在這裡填寫誓約書...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Here... please sign this.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
來，在這裡籤個名。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
..
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
...
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Yes, with this you have become a member of the Illusionary Survey Corps, welcome again!
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
很好，這樣你就正式成為幻覺調查隊的一員了。再次歡迎你！

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
If you have time during your adventure, I would like you to stop by the Illusions located in various places and help me with the investigation.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
冒險途中有空的話，希望你能順路前往各地的幻覺區域，協助我們調查。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
A dispatched investigator will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
我們派駐的調查員會為你帶路。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Then I hope you have a nice day
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
那麼，祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
I think the investigation will be much easier thanks to you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
多虧有你幫忙，調查工作應該會順利許多，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
New illusions will appear again.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
還會有新的幻覺出現。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Every new discovery takes a lot of time for us to adapt to it
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
每次發現新的幻覺現象，我們都需要花很多時間適應。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
This investigation will at least help reduce that time.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
至少，這次調查能幫我們縮短適應所需的時間。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Thank you and look forward to many more activities in the future.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官喬爾]
謝謝你，也期待今後能與你一起開展更多工作。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenhi]
Hello~~!!
scripts.translation:
[成員澤恩希]
你好~~！！

scripts.text:
[Member Zenhi]
The Illusion Investigation Corps is getting bigger little by little.
scripts.translation:
[成員澤恩希]
幻覺調查隊正在逐漸壯大。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenhi]
The more members, the more things we can do, right?
scripts.translation:
[成員澤恩希]
成員越多，我們能做的事情也越多，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
Hello, I'm Zenian, a new member of the team.
scripts.translation:
[成員澤尼安]
你好，我是澤尼安，剛加入調查隊。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
I've been paying attention to the phenomenon of dimensional rifts for a long time. Clearly, despite many subjugations, monsters are constantly appearing.
scripts.translation:
[成員澤尼安]
我關注次元裂縫現象已經很久了。明明已經進行過多次討伐，魔物卻還是不斷出現。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
It has been proven that this phenomenon also occurs in illusions, so I decided to join the Illusion Investigation Team.
scripts.translation:
[成員澤尼安]
如今已證實幻覺中也有同樣的現象，所以我決定加入幻覺調查隊。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
Good luck in the future!!
scripts.translation:
[成員澤尼安]
祝大家今後一切順利！！

scripts.text:
[Member link]
Nice to meet you, this is the Welcome Survey Team.
scripts.translation:
[成員林克]
你好，很高興認識你。我是歡迎調查組的成員。

scripts.text:
[Member link]
Investigate the ecosystem of monsters in Illusion...
scripts.translation:
[成員林克]
調查幻覺中魔物的生態...

scripts.text:
[Member link]
Also... I thought it might have something to do with the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[成員林克]
還有...我覺得這可能和次元裂縫有關。

scripts.text:
[Member link]
I hope that everyone who is working hard at this time will return safely without any incident.
scripts.translation:
[成員林克]
希望此刻正在努力調查的大家都能平安歸來，不要出任何意外。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Hello!!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
你好！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I am J-Girocker from the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
我是幻覺調查隊的J-吉羅克。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Ugh... to really come to a place like this... I wish adventurers would help me too...
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
唉...居然真的要來這種地方...真希望冒險者也能來幫幫我...

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
You haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
你還沒有加入調查隊。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Would you like to investigate the monsters here with me? It will definitely be meaningful!!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
願意和我一起調查這裡的魔物嗎？這項工作很有意義！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Please apply for membership to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the investigator in Prontera, and come!!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
請先向普隆德拉的調查員<NAVI>[喬爾]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申請加入，然後再過來！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Hello!!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
你好！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I am J-Girocker from the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
我是幻覺調查隊的J-吉羅克。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Ugh... To come to a place like this...
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
唉...居然跑到這種地方來了...

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I usually pretended to be brave, but I think I was conscious of Elysia, the member I have a crush on.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
我平時總是假裝勇敢...其實是因為我一直在意暗戀的隊員伊莉西亞。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Actually, I'm the one who's more timid than anyone else... heck
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
說真的，我才是最膽小的那個...唉。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Anyway... I'm in charge of investigating this place.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
總之，這裡的調查由我負責。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Have you heard about the investigation from Captain Joel? Adventurer, you have to completely hunt 100 monsters by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
你聽指揮官喬爾說過調查的事了嗎？冒險者，你得獨自擊殺100只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Would you like to participate in the investigation of this place?
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
你願意參與這裡的調查嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Then should I ask another adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
那我只好去問問其他冒險者了...

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I like it!!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
太好了！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Just kill 100 monsters of any type here.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
在這裡隨便擊殺100只魔物就行。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
那就小心行動！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Ah, that's enough for today's investigation.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
啊，今天的調查就到這裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
It will be restored tomorrow, so if you can afford it, I would appreciate it if you could come and help me with the investigation!!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
明天就會重置。如果你有空，還請再來幫我調查！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Hello, are you here today to help with the investigation?
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
你好，今天是來幫忙調查的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
The content is the same as last time.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
調查內容和上次一樣。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
只要擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。你願意參加嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
It would be nice if you could help me today...
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
你今天要是能幫幫我就好了...

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I like it!!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
太好了！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Just kill 100 monsters of any type here.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
在這裡擊殺100只任意種類的魔物就行。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
那就小心行動！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
You're back safely!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
你平安回來了！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Okay... Then hmm... I'll have to wait and see how much monsters spawn for a while.
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
好...嗯...接下來我得觀察一陣子，看看魔物的重新整理情況。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Leave the rest to me!! Thanks!!
scripts.translation:
[吉羅克]
剩下的交給我吧！！謝謝！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Oh, must you have a hard time enduring the cold here?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
這裡這麼冷，你一定很難熬吧？

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Come back when you're a little hotter.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
等你暖和些再回來吧。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff== This is a level 120 or higher quest. ==^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff== 這是等級達到120級或以上才能接取的任務。 ==^000000

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Hello~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
你好~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I'm Elysia from the Illusion Investigation Team~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
我是幻覺調查隊的伊莉西亞~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
It's really cold here...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
這裡真的好冷啊...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I'd like to ask the adventurer for help...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
冒險者，能不能請你幫個忙...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
You haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
你還沒有加入調查隊。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
If you don't mind, why don't you join the Illusionary Survey Corps? Then you can help me!!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
如果你不介意，要不要加入幻覺調查隊？這樣就能幫幫我了！！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Please apply for membership to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera, and come!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
請先向普隆德拉的指揮官<NAVI>[喬爾]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申請加入，然後過來找我！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Hello~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
你好~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I'm Elysia from the Illusion Investigation Team~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
我是幻覺調查隊的伊莉西亞~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
It's really cold here...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
這裡真的好冷啊...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I never thought I would be sent to such a dangerous place alone... I wanted to come with Jirocker...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
沒想到我會被單獨派到這麼危險的地方...真希望能和吉羅克一起來。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Well, even if there was a Jirocker, he's a coward, so I'd be in a position to protect him...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
不過就算吉羅克來了，他也很膽小，到時候恐怕還得由我來保護他...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
You pretended to be brave... but I already noticed
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
你一直在裝勇敢...其實我早就看出來了。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Is Jirocker doing his investigation safely in the abandoned village? I'm worried.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
吉羅克在廢棄村莊裡調查還安全嗎？我有點擔心。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Hmm... Actually, now is not the time to worry about Jirocker, Adventurer. Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
嗯...冒險者，現在還不是擔心吉羅克的時候。你能幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Did you hear that this is an investigation into how the monster population is maintained? Many adventurers come here to hunt, but it's a bit lacking.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
聽說過這次調查是為了查明魔物數量為何能維持不變嗎？很多冒險者都來這裡狩獵，不過人數還是不太夠。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
It's easy to figure out the number of monsters when you deal with them hotly. How about you? Would you like to participate in the investigation of this place?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
和魔物交戰時，正好能觀察它們的數量。你願意參與這裡的調查嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Yeah, that's right...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
嗯，沒錯...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Then I'll be shivering a little longer...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
那我還得繼續在這裡發抖一陣子了...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Oh yes!! Thanks!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
太好了！！謝謝你！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
After entering, kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
進去後，擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I look forward to your hot hunting skills~~!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
期待你大展身手，熱火朝天地狩獵哦~~！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Ah, I think this should be enough for today!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
啊，我想今天的調查到這裡就夠了！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
If you come after tomorrow, you'll have something else to do~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
明天再來，就有別的事情要做了哦～

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Ah, nice to meet you!! Are you here today to help with the investigation??
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
啊，很高興見到你！！今天也是來幫忙調查的嗎？？

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Your help is the same as last time~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
今天要做的事和上次一樣哦～

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。你願意參加嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Okay... I'll keep shivering in the cold...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
好吧...那我就繼續在這裡凍得發抖吧...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Thank you
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
After entering, kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
進去後，擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
那就小心行動！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Kill 100 monsters regardless of type.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物即可。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Have you finished already? You've done it hotly as expected~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
已經完成了嗎？果然幹得熱火朝天呢～

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Then I'll do the rest of the research for you~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
剩下的研究就交給我吧～

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Thank you for your hard work. I hope we can meet again!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亞]
辛苦你了，希望我們還能再見面！！

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Hello, Adventurer
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你好，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I am Radimir from the Illusion Investigation.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我是幻覺調查隊的拉迪米爾。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'm sent to such a dreary place, and honestly, I'm very afraid
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我被派到這麼陰森的地方，說實話，心裡很害怕。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'd like you to conduct the investigation together, but... you haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我本想邀請你一起調查...不過你還沒加入調查隊。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Would you like to do something meaningful with me?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
願意和我一起做件有意義的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
If you are interested, please meet <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera, and join the Investigation Team and come back.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
如果你有興趣，請去普隆德拉找指揮官<NAVI>[喬爾]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>加入調查隊，然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Hello, Adventurer
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你好，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I am Radimir from the Illusion Investigation.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我是幻覺調查隊的拉迪米爾。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'm sent to such a dreary place, and honestly, I'm very afraid
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我被派到這麼陰森的地方，說實話，心裡很害怕。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
But I've always been interested in the phenomenon of illusion, and when the investigation team was founded, I actively applied for membership.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
不過我一直對幻覺現象很感興趣，調查隊成立時，我就主動申請加入了。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Because nobody has figured it out yet
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
畢竟至今還沒有人弄清楚幻覺的真相。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
It's just the beginning of the current investigation, but it's sure to be a great first step
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
這次調查才剛剛開始，但一定會邁出重要的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Therefore, fear can be overcome by will.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
所以只要有決心，就能克服恐懼。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Investigation preparations are complete, now I'm waiting for someone who can adjust the monsters' levels.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
調查準備已經就緒，現在只等有人來調整魔物的等級。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
How about you, why don't you participate in the investigation? You joined the investigation team for that, right?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你呢？既然都加入調查隊了，為什麼不來參加調查？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'll stay here
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我會留在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Good.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
好。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Just kill 100 monsters of any type here.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
在這裡擊殺100只任意種類的魔物就行。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
The sooner the better.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
越快越好。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Then I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
那我等你回來。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
That's it for today.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
今天就到這裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
If the current trend, I think we can resume the investigation in a day or so. Please come then.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
照目前的情況，應該再過一天左右就能繼續調查了。到時候請再來。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Hello, are you here today to help with the investigation?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你好，今天是來幫忙調查的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Please execute the operation as it was then.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
請按上次的流程繼續調查。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Would you like to participate in the task of killing 100 monsters of any type?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
願意參加擊殺100只任意種類魔物的任務嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
You acted meaninglessly, I'm disappointed.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你這樣做毫無意義，真讓我失望。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Thank you
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Then I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
那我等你回來。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
You came through quickly, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
你這麼快就回來了，多謝。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
That makes it easier to work out the numbers.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
這樣一來，統計數量就容易多了。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I will finish the rest of the work soon and report it to the investigation team. Thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米爾]
我會盡快完成剩下的工作，並向調查隊彙報。辛苦你了。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Hello!!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
你好！！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I'm Machoko from the Illusion Investigation Team~
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我是幻覺調查隊的瑪喬可～

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I really wanted to be dispatched to this place, but I was lucky.
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我一直很想被派到這裡來，能如願以償真是太幸運了。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
These damn teddy bears~~ The teddy bears...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
這些該死的泰迪熊～～泰迪熊...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
But it's impossible for me... I don't have enough strength... But you haven't joined the investigation team yet...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
可我一個人對付不了...實力不夠...而你還沒加入調查隊...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
You can sign up by going to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera. Sign up and come here~
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
去普隆德拉找指揮官<NAVI>[喬爾]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>報名加入，然後再來這裡找我～

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Hello!!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
你好！！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I'm Machoko from the Illusion Investigation Team~
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我是幻覺調查隊的瑪喬可～

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I really wanted to be dispatched to this place, but I was lucky.
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我一直很想被派到這裡來，能如願以償真是太幸運了。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
These damn teddy bears~~ The teddy bears...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
這些該死的泰迪熊～～泰迪熊...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
But it's impossible for me... I don't have enough strength... He looks easy... but he's so strong...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
可我一個人對付不了...實力不夠...那傢伙看著挺好欺負...其實強得很...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I thought I could do it all by myself... I took it too lightly... Huh...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我還以為自己一個人就能搞定...真是太輕敵了...唉...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I unknowingly and vigorously attacked and came back with a lot of beating... I almost died...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我當時一時衝動就猛衝上去，結果被揍得夠嗆...差點沒命...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I barely recovered... I think it's possible to investigate, but you look a little strong?
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我好不容易才緩過來...調查應該還能繼續，不過你看起來挺強的？

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Then help me... I need someone to take control of those vicious teddy bears...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
那就拜託你了...我需要有人幫忙對付那些兇惡的泰迪熊...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
How about it? Do you want to join the investigation??
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
怎麼樣？願意參加調查嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Yes... I'm about to collapse after I've been here... Like a man without blood or tears...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
是啊...我在這裡待得快撐不下去了...都快變得麻木不仁了...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Okay! Let's go!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
好！出發吧！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Go and beat up about 100 of them, and come, it doesn't matter what type, blow them up as you see them!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
去擊殺大約100只，然後回來。什麼種類都行，看到就儘管打倒！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I... can't even move... Here... I'll wait...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我...連動都動不了了...我就在這裡...等你...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Well, no more today
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
好了，今天先到這裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Come back after a day!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
一天後再來！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Oh, nice to meet you! Welcome back!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
啊，很高興見到你！歡迎回來！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
You must have come here because your body itches.
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
你一定是手癢了才會來這裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Would you like to participate in the investigation work here again today??
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
今天還想參加這裡的調查嗎？？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
What...then why did you come??
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
什麼...那你來這裡做什麼？？

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Sure, that's how it should be
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
好啊，就該這樣。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Regardless of the type, just beat 100 of them and bring them back.
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
不管是什麼種類，擊殺100只後回來找我就行。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I'll be waiting for you, so hurry up!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我會在這裡等你，快去快回！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Go and beat up about 100 of them, and come, it doesn't matter what type, blow them up as you see them!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
去擊殺大約100只，然後回來。什麼種類都行，看到就儘管打倒！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I've been waiting for you... finish quickly and come back...
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
我一直在等你...快點完成後回來...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Um...but that's about it... um...yeah!! good!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
嗯...差不多就是這樣...嗯...好！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Leave the rest to me!! I'll report the results to the investigation team, now you can go and rest.
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
剩下的交給我！！我會把結果彙報給調查隊，你可以去休息了。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Thank you~~
scripts.translation:
[瑪喬可]
謝謝你～～

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Hello!
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你好！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I'm Orian, a contract worker in the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
我是奧裡安，幻覺調查隊僱來的臨時工。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Actually, it's not something I'm keen on...but I need the money...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
其實我對這份工作不太感興趣...不過我需要錢...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
It would be nice if you could help me... is that possible?
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
要是你能幫幫我就好了...可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Uh, but you haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
呃，不過你還沒加入調查隊。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Please apply for membership to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera, and come!!
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
請先去普隆德拉找指揮官<NAVI>[喬爾]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申請加入，然後再過來！！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Hello!
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你好！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I'm Orian, a contract worker in the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
我是奧裡安，幻覺調查隊僱來的臨時工。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
The Illumination Investigation Team is a newly formed organization, so it must have been a little understaffed. I saw an announcement that they would hire part-time contract workers.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
幻覺調查隊剛成立不久，人手可能不太夠。我看到公告說他們要招兼職臨時工。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Actually, I'm not interested in illusions... I'm busy making a living.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
說實話，我對幻覺不感興趣...我還得忙著賺錢呢。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Huh... It's all about money, I'm going to buy a new set of clothes when I get paid.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
唉，說到底還是為了錢。發了工資，我就去買套新衣服。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
But even that isn't easy... I've been waiting for an investigator like you to come because I think it's going to be very difficult on my own.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
不過賺錢也不容易...我一直盼著有調查員來幫忙，自己一個人實在應付不來。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
It would be nice if you could help me... is that possible?
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
要是你能幫幫我就好了...可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Would you like to participate in this Illusion Investigation?
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你願意參加這次幻覺調查嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Ah... I finally found an investigator... Ah... I want money...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
啊...終於等到調查員了...啊...我想賺錢...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Oh, thank you
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
哦，謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Please go up one floor from here and go to the bleak Guyang Palace.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
從這裡再往上一層，前往荒涼的龜陽宮吧。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
And please kill 100 monsters there, regardless of type.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
在那裡擊殺100只魔物，種類不限。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I'll be waiting for you here. Have a safe trip!!
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
我會在這裡等你。一路小心！！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
You're not fit to do research right now.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你現在還不適合做調查。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I think it will be fine by tomorrow, can you come back after tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
我想明天應該就能繼續了。你明天再來好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Hello, you are the only one who can help me...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你好...你是唯一能幫我的人...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
What we need to do is the same as last time...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
要做的事和上次一樣...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Are you going to help me with the illusion investigation again?
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你願意再次幫我調查幻覺嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Aigoo...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
唉呀...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Sob.....
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
嗚嗚...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Oops... Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
哎呀...謝謝你...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Go to the bleak archery and kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
去荒涼的射箭場，擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Then be careful...
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
那就小心點...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Destroy 100 monsters of any type in the bleak Archery.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
在荒涼的射箭場擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
You came home safely.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
你平安回來了。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Uh... You took it down a lot faster than I expected.. You... you were a master??
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
呃...你完成得比我預想的快多了...你、你是高手嗎？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
That should make the rest of the work easier.
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
這樣一來，剩下的工作就容易多了。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Thank you~ Thank you for your hard work!!
scripts.translation:
[奧裡安]
謝謝你～辛苦了！！

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
你好，很高興認識你。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I am Sheshin belonging to the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
我是幻覺調查隊的謝辛。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I thought my fighting power would be enough to investigate here... but I guess I made a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
我原以為自己的實力足以在這裡調查...看來是我估計錯了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
The monsters here are much stronger than I expected.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
這裡的魔物比我預想的強得多。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Ah... I'm really proud of myself... but I need help... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
唉...我還挺自信的...可還是需要幫忙...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Adventurer hasn't joined the Illusion Investigation Team yet.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
冒險者，你還沒有加入幻覺調查隊。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Would you like to join the Illusionary Investigation Team? Wouldn't it be exciting to explore unknown phenomena?
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
你想加入幻覺調查隊嗎？探索未知現象不是很令人興奮嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
If you would like to sign up, please go see Commander <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI> in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
想報名的話，請去普隆德拉找指揮官<NAVI>[喬爾]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
很高興認識你。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I am Sheshin belonging to the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
我是幻覺調查隊的謝辛。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I was active as a member of the Continental Guard in the past. At that time, I was tasked with exploring the dimensional rift created by the power of the demon king Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
我以前是大陸衛兵的一員，曾奉命調查魔王夢羅克之力所形成的次元裂縫。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I was guessing to some extent that the illusions appearing everywhere had something to do with the power of the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
我早就猜測，各地出現的幻覺可能與次元裂縫之力有關。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
It has been officially announced by Commander Joel that the Illusion is a phenomenon caused by a dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
指揮官喬爾已經正式宣佈，幻覺現象是由次元裂縫引起的。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
And soon a new illusion was discovered, yes... right here
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
沒過多久，我們又發現了一處新的幻覺...沒錯，就在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I joined the Illusion Investigation Team because I wanted to see it with my own eyes, and now I am here.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
我加入幻覺調查隊，就是想親眼看看這種現象。現在我終於來到這裡了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
But I ran into a little problem...
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
不過，我遇到了一點麻煩...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I thought my fighting power would be enough to investigate here... but I guess I made a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
我原以為自己的實力足以在這裡調查...看來是我判斷失誤了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
The monsters here are much stronger than I expected.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
這裡的魔物比我預想的強得多。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Ah... I really hurt my pride... but I need help...
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
唉...這可真傷自尊...不過我確實需要幫忙...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Hmm... I think it's possible enough for you as an adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
嗯...以你的冒險者實力，應該足以勝任...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I feel that you have much more power than me.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
我覺得你的實力比我強多了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Would you like to help me investigate the illusions in this sector?
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
願意幫我調查這片區域的幻覺嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
This must be a good opportunity for adventurers...
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
這對冒險者來說應該是個不錯的機會...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Good.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
好。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Please kill 100 monsters of any type located inside here.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
請在這裡擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Then, please travel carefully without getting hurt.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
路上請多加小心，別受傷了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
You don't have to do any more research today.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
今天不用再繼續調查了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Can you come back tomorrow if you want?
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
如果你願意，明天再來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Welcome, you're here to help investigate the illusion, right?
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
歡迎回來，你是來幫忙調查幻覺現象的吧？

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
You can do the same thing as last time.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
今天照上次那樣做就行。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。你願意參加嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
It's a pity, it's sad that I still lack strength.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
真遺憾...看來我的實力還是不夠。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Good.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
好。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Then, please travel carefully without getting hurt.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
路上請多加小心，別受傷了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I see... you finished quickly and came back.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
原來如此...你很快就完成並回來了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I need to investigate further to see if the phenomenon here is also affected by the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
我還得繼續調查，確認這裡的現象是否也受到次元裂縫的影響。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I'll do the work myself from now on.
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
接下來的工作我自己來做。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Thank you so much for your help
scripts.translation:
[謝辛]
真的非常感謝你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
This is Cassis of the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我是幻覺調查隊的卡西斯。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Although this place is full of monsters, I still feel comfortable here.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
這裡雖然到處都是魔物，但我待著反而覺得很自在。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
I heard that one of the investigators is coming to help... is that you?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我聽說有位調查員會來幫忙...是你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Oh, that's not true. You're not a member of the investigation team... Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
哦，不對，你還不是調查隊的成員...嗯。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Would you like to join the Illusionary Investigation Team too? Would you like to investigate strange phenomena?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你也想加入幻覺調查隊嗎？想不想和我們一起調查這些奇異現象？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
If you don't mind, please apply for membership with the Commander <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI> in Prontera and come!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
如果你願意，請去普隆德拉找指揮官<NAVI>[喬爾]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申請加入，然後再來這裡！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Hello
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
This is Cassis of the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我是幻覺調查隊的卡西斯。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Although this place is full of monsters, I still feel comfortable here.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
這裡雖然到處都是魔物，但我待著反而覺得很自在。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
I don't like to get involved with people. Before I joined the investigation team, I ran a shop in Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我不喜歡和人打交道。加入調查隊之前，我在普隆德拉開過一家店...

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
I don't like the feeling of being crowded, so it was hard to bear... I guess meeting a lot of people was stressful for my personality.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我不喜歡被人群圍著，實在很難受...對我這種性格來說，跟很多人打交道壓力太大了。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Although this place is full of monsters, I still feel comfortable here, at least the monsters don't talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
這裡雖然到處都是魔物，我待著卻很自在。至少魔物不會跟我說話。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Ummm, by the way, I heard that one of the investigators is coming to help... I guess that's you?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
嗯，對了，聽說有位調查員要來幫忙...我想那個人就是你吧？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Have you heard the general information from Captain Joel? You just need to display your fighting power without hesitation!!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
指揮官喬爾跟你說過大致情況了嗎？你只要放手展示自己的實力就行！！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Would you like to participate in the investigation of this place?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你願意參與這裡的調查嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Uh, then who the hell is the investigative team coming...?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
呃，那來幫忙的調查員到底在哪兒...？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Okay, thank you
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
好，謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Just kill 100 monsters of any type that exist here.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
在這裡擊殺100只任意種類的魔物就行。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Then good luck.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
那就祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Today's investigation is complete.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
今天的調查到此結束。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
It would be nice if you could come tomorrow too... Please stop by if you have time.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
明天你要是也能來就好了...有空的話過來一趟吧。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Hello, are you here today to help with the investigation?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你好，今天是來幫忙調查的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
The content is the same as last time.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
今天的內容和上次一樣。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。你願意參加嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
It would be nice if you could help me today...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你今天要是能幫幫我就好了...

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
I like it!!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
太好了！！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
After entering, kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
進去後，擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
那就小心行動！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Welcome, you're done!!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
歡迎回來，任務完成了！！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
You've worked really hard. Are there any injuries anywhere?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
辛苦了。有沒有哪裡受傷？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Leave the rest to me. Thanks
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
剩下的交給我吧，謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Hello
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I need help with my research work, so I'm looking for a suitable helper.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我的研究需要人手，所以正在找合適的幫手。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
You're not the right person yet, sorry.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
抱歉，你目前還不合適。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Hello~
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你好～

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I am Lista who is active in the Illusion Investigation Team.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我是利斯特，幻覺調查隊的一員。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
It's been a while since I came down to the deep sea with Master.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
好久沒和師父一起下到深海區域了。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'm always working hard, but I don't think Master still approves of me.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我一直很努力，可師父似乎還是不認可我。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Just in time, the Illusion Investigation Team said they needed to investigate the deep sea here, so I quickly applied.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
正好幻覺調查隊需要調查這片深海，我就趕緊報名了。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'm sure Master would be happy if we could get even a little bit more information about the deep sea here as part of the investigation team!!!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
如果能作為調查隊的一員，多收集一些這裡的深海情報，師父一定會很高興！！！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Would you like to come with me?
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你願意和我一起去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Uh, but you haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
呃，不過你還沒有加入調查隊。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Please apply for membership to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera, and come!!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
請先去普隆德拉找指揮官<NAVI>[喬爾]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申請加入，然後再過來！！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I was anxiously waiting for a member to help me with the investigation, and it went really well~
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我正著急等人來幫忙調查呢，幸好你及時趕到了～

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Would you like to participate in this deep sea investigation?
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
願意參加這次深海調查嗎？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 參加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不參加

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'm neglected like this... It's wrong to be acknowledged by Master...
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我總被這樣冷落...看來師父根本不打算認可我...

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Oh, thank you!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
哦，謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Go down to the lower level dungeon of the Abyssal Undersea Cave and defeat 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
前往深淵海底洞穴下層，擊殺100只任意種類的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
那就小心行動！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Let's finish here for today.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
今天就先到這裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I should be able to get back to work tomorrow, could you talk to me again then??
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我明天應該就能繼續工作了，到時候你能再來找我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Hello, would you like to do some research with me today??
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你好，今天想和我一起調查嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Just do what you did last time!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
照上次那樣做就行！

If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:

Today... I... incompetent... disciple...
scripts.translation:

今天...我...真是個沒用的弟子...

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Good! Got it
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
很好，明白了。

Go down to the lower level of the Abyssal Undersea Cave and kill 100 monsters of any type.

Kill 100 monsters of any type.

[Lister]
How was it? Are the monsters on the lower levels really strong??
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
怎麼樣？下層的魔物是不是很強？

scripts.text:
[Lister]
You worked hard... Then I'll have to go down carefully.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
辛苦你了...看來我也得小心地下去調查。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'll do the rest, thank you so much!!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
剩下的交給我吧，非常感謝！！
